system.name: VITRON
system.one_liner: A unified pixel-level vision LLM that understands, generates, segments and edits both images and videos.

content.variant_note: four tinted task-cluster quadrants placed on two gradient axes around a central logo, each task a pale tab over one real sample
content.argues: One model covers four clusters of vision tasks, from understanding to generation and from low-level to high-level semantics, with an example for each task.
content.subject: A two-axis capability map of 23 vision tasks in four quadrants around the VITRON logo, each with a sample.

lessons.what_to_learn: Lay a capability map out as tinted quadrants placed by two named axes drawn as gradient arrows on the edges, put the model logo in a white disc at the junction, and give each task one pale tab over a real sample, all in one hue per cluster.
lessons.suits: generalist models or benchmarks that cover many tasks in a few clusters and need one sample per task, with a clear two-axis organising idea.

evidence: VITRON supports four main task clusters of visions, spanning visual comprehension to visual generation, from low level to high level.
unified support for both images and videos, and insufficient coverage across various vision tasks

summary: VITRON is a unified pixel-level vision LLM that understands, generates, segments and edits images and videos. Figure 1 is a two-axis capability map: gradient arrows along the top (low-level to high-level visual semantics) and the left edge (visual understanding to visual generating) frame four tinted quadrants, each with a saturated header chip: Vision Segmentation & Grounding, Pixel-level Vision Understanding, Vision Synthesis & Generation, and Vision Editing & Inpainting. Pale tabs name 23 tasks, each over one real sample (masks, boxes, film strips, question-answer text, retrieval scores, before and after edits), and the VITRON logo sits in a white disc at the centre.
summary_zh: VITRON 是统一的像素级视觉大模型，覆盖理解、生成、分割与编辑。图 1 用顶部（低层到高层语义）和左侧（理解到生成）两条渐变箭头界定四个色块，共 23 个任务，每个任务配一个真实样例，中央放置 VITRON 标志。
notes: No paragraph mentions the figure; roles come from the caption, abstract and picture. Prior labels had contribution-mosaic first; the two-axis placement of clusters makes scope-overview the primary kind, with capability-cards as the second. The grey #d8d8d8 area in the digest is backing rectangles behind thumbnails, not a visible colour. The 23 tasks are counted from the tab titles.
